selection_rule:
Within each fixed family quota, rank expert_train canonical task IDs by SHA256(UTF8('SI-P3-S-v1
'+family+'
'+task_id+'
')), then task_id; take the first quota. For each fixed selected task, consider only dataset_split=train rows passing the production format/map/public checks and both local tokenizers' 2048 no-truncation/prefix check; rank by SHA256(UTF8('SI-P3-S-row-v1
'+task_id+'
'+step_index+'
'+stored_prompt_sha256+'
'+completion+'
')), step_index tie, then raw line SHA only as final deterministic tie. No task substitution; if none, status NOT_READY.
